design-installation-for-the-customer-exp.title: Design & Installation for the Customer Experience (Catering & Social Spaces) | CPC
design-installation-for-the-customer-exp.section:
How to Use
                
                                            You can use this framework by joining TUCO. Just complete TUCO's application form or call TUCO on 0161 713 3420 to request membership.If you don't have CPC membership, firstly join CPC - it's free for educational organisations.Associate membership is free to all educational establishments with an in house catering provision, for more information on the benefits of TUCO membership, please see the About TUCO page. Once you have access to their site, you will be able to view guidance documentation. If you require any assistance, please contact the Contracting Manager as listed below.Institutions can call off from the Design and Installation for the Customer Experience framework through one of the following three methods:1. Direct award2. Utilising the quality scoring from the framework tender and reassessing just price3. Mini competition
